document: 121 complete original card designs with exact native copy
scope: 121 original complete-card plates; unchanged canonical copy and seven retained backs; same-operator review only.

binding_sources.reference_role: Design language only; original captain and all original scenes required; no literal reference crop.

historical_brief_context.note: Earlier pose, gender, camera, no-joke and literal KAPTAN constraints are superseded for this delivery by the owner correction. The previous full manifest remains in Git history. Planned scene descriptions below are prompts; selected assets and individual complete-card reviews establish the actual delivery.

global_prohibitions: No canonical copy or mechanic change.
No imported franchise character, quotation, logo or costume imitation.
No new hidden-information clue, allegiance colour code or faction emblem.
No missing-art fallback or review that omits native card copy.
No independent, owner, human-play or physical-print acceptance claim.

records.source_scene_plan: A gaunt older lookout with an impossibly long neck, hooked nose, knitted cap and narrow suspicious eyes peers through a long brass telescope. His free hand indignantly pushes away a short measuring stick offered by a skeptical shipmate. Distant sail and ragged rigging. His wounded confidence is the joke, not failing eyesight.

current_implementation.visual_review_note: Uzun boyun, ölçü çubuğu itirazı ve tek dürbün okunuyor; başlık/kural/flavor çakışmıyor.

records.source_scene_plan: An angular middle-aged woman cartographer, rolled sleeves and stubborn raised eyebrow, spreads a chart whose shore occupies only a tiny corner; the rest is crowded with abstract pen hatching.
